method: Selected scenarios use isolated temporary saves, actual local provider and production generation/validation path. No user campaign access. Prose requires manual assessment; test success is not semantic acceptance.

manual_review.assessment: Four mechanically ready offers, six provider attempts,37.79seconds overall. Crew addresses boss and new-life speaker addresses Nico. Leader invents a last-week toll agreement. Tool callback invents prior parts secured, then asks player to collect from a supplier whom it describes as owed payment. These fail historical and payer/payee consistency. New-life first attempt references locked Russo Motor Works; correction stays at laundry. Default unchanged.
